sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows_in_last_snapshot, count(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity <> 0) AS open_positions, COALESCE(round(sum(abs(market_exposure)) FILTER (WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity <> 0),2),0) AS capital_at_risk_usd FROM positions WHERE captured_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-04 13:00:00+00'
